school_name: Citadel Military College of South Carolina
title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Discover free social spaces and activities at The Citadel, from historic museum galleries and scenic riverfront parks to iconic military parades open to the public.

cards.title: Watch a Dress Parade
cards.subtitle: Summerall Field
cards.notes: Observe the South Carolina Corps of Cadets march in formation most Fridays at 3:45 PM. It is free to watch from the bleachers; arrive early for parking.
cards.short_summary: Attend a traditional military dress parade featuring the Regimental Band and Pipes on the main campus parade ground.
cards.evidence_claim: Citadel parades are free to attend and open to the public.
cards.source_title: The Citadel Parades - The Citadel Regimental Band and Pipes
cards.access_notes: Open to the public on scheduled Fridays during the academic year; check the online schedule for specific dates.

cards.title: Explore Citadel History
cards.subtitle: Daniel Library, 3rd Floor
cards.notes: View uniforms, class rings, and military artifacts tracing the college's history since 1842. Located on the third floor of the library with no admission fee.
cards.short_summary: A campus museum showcasing the military, academic, and social history of The Citadel through various exhibits.
cards.evidence_claim: The Citadel Museum opened in 1960 and is located on the third floor of the library building... Admission is free.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public during library hours, typically weekdays from 7:30 AM to 9:00 PM.

cards.title: Visit Summerall Chapel
cards.subtitle: Avenue of Remembrance
cards.notes: Step inside this historic cruciform chapel to see the regimental colors and stained glass. It serves as a quiet space for reflection and community worship.
cards.short_summary: A non-denominational shrine and place of worship on campus known for its beautiful architecture and military flags.
cards.evidence_claim: Summerall Chapel advocates for religious expression by supporting students, faculty, staff and the greater Charleston community.
cards.access_notes: Generally open to visitors during the day; Sunday services are held at 9:00 AM.

cards.title: Relax at Hampton Park
cards.subtitle: Adjacent to Campus
cards.notes: Walk or run the trails at this 60-acre park located right next to campus. It features extensive floral displays and a physical fitness trail used by cadets.
cards.short_summary: One of Charleston's largest public parks, offering green space, gardens, and trails immediately beside The Citadel.
cards.evidence_claim: The physical fitness trail is a popular spot for The Citadel students who live next door to the park... Grounds are free.
cards.access_notes: Public park open daily from dawn to dusk; vehicles restricted during specific 'Walk, Run & Roll' hours.

cards.title: Study in Daniel Library
cards.subtitle: Avenue of Remembrance
cards.notes: Utilize collaborative study rooms or the Prioleau Reading Room for quiet work. The library serves as the campus information hub with free access for students.
cards.short_summary: The primary academic library on campus offering various study spaces and historical collections.
cards.evidence_claim: Facilities include four collaborative study rooms, two classrooms, and the Prioleau Reading Room.
cards.access_notes: Open to students and the public; typical hours are 7:30 AM to 9:00 PM on weekdays.

cards.title: Access the Beach
cards.subtitle: Isle of Palms
cards.notes: Cadets and students can access the beach and use the outdoor facilities at this off-campus property. Parking is available for the Citadel family.
cards.short_summary: A college-owned oceanfront venue on Isle of Palms where students can enjoy beach access and outdoor amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: Beach access will continue to be available for The Citadel Family, regardless of the event booked in the Ballroom or Pavilion.
cards.source_title: Frequently Asked Questions - The Citadel Beach Club
cards.access_notes: Restricted to the Citadel family (students, faculty, staff, and alumni); not open to the general public.

cards.title: Workout at Deas Hall
cards.subtitle: Campus Fitness Center
cards.notes: Use the cardio and weight rooms or register for a free locker to store your gear. This facility is the hub for intramural and recreational athletics.
cards.short_summary: The campus recreation center providing fitness equipment and locker facilities for the student body.
cards.evidence_claim: There is no fee to use a locker; however, lockers must be registered in the First Floor Equipment Room.
cards.source_title: Students - Intramural, Club and Recreational Athletics - The Citadel
cards.access_notes: Open to students with valid ID; users must provide their own locks for the free lockers.

cards.title: Stroll the Riverfront
cards.subtitle: West Side of Campus
cards.notes: Walk along the banks of the Ashley River for scenic views of the water and the Swain Boating Center. A peaceful spot for a sunset walk.
cards.short_summary: The scenic western edge of campus bordering the Ashley River, offering paths and water views.
cards.evidence_claim: Stroll our scenic riverfront campus or explore it online.
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible campus grounds open year-round.

cards.title: Hang Out in Mark Clark Hall
cards.subtitle: Student Union
cards.notes: Gather in the lounge areas or the auditorium of the student union. It houses the bookstore and dining options, but the common spaces are free to use.
cards.short_summary: The central student activity building on campus with lounges and meeting spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: In Spring 2026, we will be worshipping in the Mark Clark Hall Auditorium... MCH is the building just past the Chapel.
cards.source_title: FAQs — TCSC - The Church at Summerall Chapel
cards.access_notes: Open daily; serves as a primary gathering spot for cadets during free time.

cards.title: Visit the War Memorial
cards.subtitle: Near Summerall Field
cards.notes: Pay respects at this monument dedicated to Citadel alumni who gave their lives in service. It is an outdoor site accessible to all visitors.
cards.short_summary: A solemn campus landmark honoring the sacrifices of Citadel graduates in various military conflicts.
cards.evidence_claim: Explore campus landmarks... Discover iconic landmarks like Summerall Chapel, the Daniel Library and The Citadel Museum.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor memorial open to the public 24/7.
